follow-up time: Ongoing, questionnaires mailed out every 3-4 years
exposure: maternal and paternal age at multiple delivery
Zygosity (differed among collaborating public health centers)
Maternal and paternal age at multiple delivery
cohort: Over 7800 twins and 4241 higher order multiples, and their families, recruited from public health centers in West Japan in the 1990s
finding: This article describes the establishment and goals of the West Japan Twins and Higher Order Multiple Births Registry, which aims to conduct research on human genetics and maternal and child health, and provide information for families with multiples.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery is one of the exposures collected in the registry.
